title: 5 SQL problems
description: The audit's first weekly KPI. Consistency beats intensity — five a week for a year is 260 problems.

title: 1 portfolio artifact update
description: Move one portfolio artefact forward every single week, however slightly.

title: 1 interview case
description: One written case per week, all the way through to a recommendation.

title: 2 mock interviews
description: The core cadence from month 10 onward. Starting early is free.

title: 3 LinkedIn posts or comments of substance
description: Substance is the operative word — the audit explicitly warns against generic content.

title: 5 networking conversations
description: Conversations, not connection requests. The difference is everything.

title: 1 estimation exercise
description: Part 7 practice cadence. Estimation is the cheapest round to make reliable.

title: 1 published case study
description: The monthly artefact. Twenty-four of these is the whole portfolio.

title: 1 product teardown
description: Public teardowns build distribution while proving product sense.

title: 1 new portfolio project
description: One new project started or completed each month.

title: 20 meaningful new professional connections
description: Roughly five a week. Quality gate: could you say why you connected?

title: 5 tailored job applications
description: Ramping to more later. Tailored is the operative word.

title: 1 long-form article
description: The Part 4 throughput commitment. One a month for twenty-four months.

title: 1 interview performance review
description: Review your own scores monthly and find the repeating criticism.

title: Refine behavioural stories
description: Part 7 asks for monthly refinement of the behavioural story library.

title: 3 public artifacts
description: Quarterly output floor. Three per quarter is twenty-four over the programme.

title: 20 mock interviews completed
description: Quarterly total. Sustains the two-per-week cadence.

title: 1 major skill certification or demonstrable project
description: Demonstrable is the qualifier — a certificate alone does not count.

title: 1 measurable improvement in interview performance
description: The score has to move. Track it, do not assume it.

title: Read 2–3 books
description: The Part 4 reading cadence.

title: Portfolio review
description: Quarterly checkpoint: is the portfolio still the strongest version of itself?

title: Resume update with quantified impact
description: Quarterly checkpoint. Every bullet carries a number or it gets rewritten.

title: Mock interview benchmark
description: Quarterly checkpoint: score yourself against the same rubric each quarter.

title: Networking and referral audit
description: Quarterly checkpoint: how many referrals and recruiter conversations did you generate?

title: 6–8 high-quality public portfolio artifacts
description: The audit's headline success metric.

title: Grow network by 1,000 relevant connections
description: Twenty a week, fifty weeks.
